recognize_zh: Lambda 輕鏈原位雜交（ISH）中，散在許多藍黑色陽性漿細胞，數量與 kappa 染色相當，表示漿細胞為多株性（polytypic），支持反應性背景而非淋巴瘤。
features: In situ hybridization for lambda light chain mRNA (blue chromogen) on tissue, low power
Numerous scattered lambda-positive plasma cells, singly and in loose clusters
Positive cells distributed through a fibrous and adipose-containing stroma
Numbers comparable to, though somewhat fewer than, kappa-positive cells on the paired stain
Background histiocytes and stroma are negative
describe_en: In situ hybridization for lambda light chain shows numerous scattered and loosely clustered positive plasma cells throughout the lesion. Compared with the paired kappa stain, the kappa:lambda ratio is within the polytypic range, without evidence of light-chain restriction. The large histiocytes and stroma are negative. Findings indicate a polytypic plasma cell population, supporting a reactive plasmacytic component as seen in extranodal Rosai-Dorfman disease.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma shows light-chain restricted plasma cells (kappa:lambda markedly skewed) with a CD20+ B-cell infiltrate, unlike the polytypic plasma cells of RDD.
Plasmacytoma consists of sheets of monotypic plasma cells, without the S100+ emperipolesis-rich histiocytes of RDD.
IgG4-RD also has polytypic plasma cells but shows storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis, and lacks large S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis.
